vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: roadmap
Version: 1.0.0

The roadmap skill is a simple local utility for managing a list of items in a text file. The shell script (scripts/script.sh) implements basic add, list, and export functions using standard local file operations within the user's home directory (~/.local/share/roadmap/). There is no evidence of network activity, data exfiltration, or malicious intent in the code or the agent instructions (SKILL.md).

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose: a small offline roadmap CLI that stores data under ~/.local/share/roadmap and does not request credentials or network access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the provided script and SKILL.md: the code implements run/list/add/status/export commands and stores data locally. There are no unexpected credentials, binaries, or external services required for the documented features.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the user to run the CLI and states data stays local; the bundled script honors that by using XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share/roadmap. Minor note: the export path in the script calls python3 to build JSON but the SKILL.md does not declare python3 as a requirement.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with a bundled script). Nothing is downloaded or extracted at install time; the script will create its own data directory under the user's home when invoked.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No credentials or sensitive environment variables are requested. The script reads XDG_DATA_HOME (standard) to determine storage location — expected behavior. Again, python3 is invoked conditionally during export but is not declared as a required binary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true or elevated privileges and only writes to its own data directory. It does not modify other skills or system-wide configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is small and internally consistent: it stores data locally in ~/.local/share/roadmap and does not request secrets or network access. Before installing or running, consider: (1) review the bundled scripts (they are short and readable) to confirm behavior; (2) be aware the export path uses python3 — ensure python3 is present or the export json command will fallback to an empty list; (3) the skill will create and append files under your home directory (~/.local/share/roadmap), so if those files may contain sensitive information back them up or store them elsewhere; (4) the skill source and homepage are unknown — if you prefer provenance, obtain a version from a known publisher or run it in a sandbox first. Overall the package appears coherent with its stated offline roadmap purpose.
